Skilling baseline: active non-fight modules only; configured XP × success ÷ seconds. Recovery, passive, event, stamina, streak, crit, medal, hub, ad, and global bonuses excluded.
Fishing rows use configured card values; actual fishing rates vary with tool, location, and batch behavior.
